## Q1
Arrange the following in a meaningful order, from particular to general:<br>
A. Family<br>
B. Community<br>
C. Member<br>
D. Locality<br>
E. Country<br>
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

## Q1 - Options
(A) A, B, C, D, E
(B) B, C, A, E, D
(C) C, A, B, D, E
(D) E, D, C, A, B

## Q1 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2026 (22 Jun, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q8

Moving from the most specific unit outward: a Member belongs to a Family, families form a Community, communities occupy a Locality, and localities together make up a Country — C, A, B, D, E.

## Q3
Match List-I with List-II.<br>
Choose the correct answer from the options:

| List-I (Letter series) | List-II (Missing letter) |
|---|---|
| A. Q, N, K, H, E, ?<br>B. O, B, L, ?, I, D, F, E, C<br>C. Z, U, Q, N, L, ?<br>D. A, C, ?, G, I | I. C<br>II. K<br>III. B<br>IV. E |

## Q3 - Options
(A) A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
(B) A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II
(C) A-I, B-II, C-IV, D-III
(D) A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV

## Q3 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2026 (22 Jun, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q18

A: Q, N, K, H, E step down by 3, so the missing term is B (III). C: Z, U, Q, N, L decrease by 5, 4, 3, 2, so the next is K (II). D: A, C, ?, G, I step up by 2, giving E (IV). B resolves to the missing letter C (I). Hence A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV.

## Q5
Match the words with their codes.

| List-I: Word | List-II: Code |
|---|---|
| A. CRAB | I. 32 |
| B. BARK | II. 49 |
| C. OVER | III. 24 |
| D. SING | IV. 60 |

## Q5 - Options
(A) A-II, B-IV, C-I, D-III
(B) A-III, B-II, C-I, D-IV
(C) A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II
(D) A-IV, B-III, C-II, D-I

## Q5 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jan 2026 (2 Jan, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q29

The code is the sum of the positions of the letters: CRAB = 3+18+1+2 = 24, BARK = 2+1+18+11 = 32, OVER = 15+22+5+18 = 60, and SING = 19+9+14+7 = 49. Thus A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II.

## Q6

## Q6 - Options

(B) 610
(C) 702
(D) 622

## Q6 - Hint
**Answer:** A

## Q7

## Q7 - Options
(A) 15, 12, 12, 5, 8
(B) 5, 12, 12, 15, 8
(C) 8, 5, 12, 12, 15
(D) 12, 5, 12, 8, 15

## Q7 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q37

The code writes the alphabetical positions in reverse order. HELLO has positions 8, 5, 12, 12, 15, so the reversed sequence is 15, 12, 12, 5, 8. Therefore, 15, 12, 12, 5, 8 is the correct choice.

## Q9
A man walks 12 km towards south and then 7 km towards north. From here he walks 5 km towards his left. How far and in which direction is the man with reference to his starting point?

## Q9 - Options
(A) 5 km, north-west
(B) 5 km, south-west
(C) 5√2 km, south-west
(D) 5√2 km, south-east

## Q9 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jan 2025 (6 Jan, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q25

After the first two moves he is 5 km south of the start. Facing north, his left is west, so he then moves 5 km west. The displacement has equal south and west components, giving 5√2 km to the south-west.

## Q14
In a certain coding scheme:

“Family values are important” is written as “pa, ya, si, sa”.<br>
“Values are generally contagious” is written as “ya, da, ja, sa”.<br>
“Some diseases are contagious” is written as “ka, da, sa, ro”.

What are the codes for “Contagious” and “Values”?

## Q14 - Options
(A) da, sa
(B) da, si
(C) ka, ya
(D) da, ya

## Q14 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Dec 2023 (7 Dec, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q24

“Contagious” is common to the second and third sentences, giving da; “values” is common to the first and second, giving ya. Hence the pair is da, ya.

## Q16

## Q16 - Options

(B) 91
(C) 99
(D) 106

**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2023 (17 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q17

The pattern is formed by the squares of consecutive even numbers minus 1:<br>
2^2 - 1 = 3<br>

## Q17
In a certain coding scheme, 'WOMEN' is coded as '70'. How will 'CHILDREN' be coded in this scheme?

## Q17 - Options
(A) 178
(B) 143
(C) 116
(D) 73

## Q17 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2023 (17 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q23

In this coding scheme, 'WOMEN' is coded as '70'. Summing the alphabetical positions of WOMEN (W=23, O=15, M=13, E=5, N=14): 23 + 15 + 13 + 5 + 14 = 70. Applying the same logic to 'CHILDREN': C=3, H=8, I=9, L=12, D=4, R=18, E=5, N=14. The sum is 3 + 8 + 9 + 12 + 4 + 18 + 5 + 14 = 73. Therefore, the correct code is 73.
